name: ado-tf-agent
description: Azure DevOps extension: Terraform tasks + build results visualization

scripts.build:task: cd tasks/Terraform && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build:ui: cd ui && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:task && npm run build:ui
scripts.package: npm run build && npx --yes tfx-cli extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path dist
